source: round-13-verifier-spotcheck.md C1 and round-13 committed nonzero fixtures
semantics: Counts are records/notices, never unique victims. The six raw totals must remain measurable even if failed-subject metadata is missing; failure classification is a separate count of known fleet/nonfleet/unknown subjects. Scopes are never summed.
positive_alarm_policy: kernel_oom_notice or observed UNIT_RESULT=oom-kill => critical OOM_KILL_JOURNAL and DRIFT independently of subject classification; user unit_sigkill_record => KILL_SIGNAL_JOURNAL WARN
routing_policy: UNIT_FAILURE_JOURNAL is fleet only; UNIT_FAILURE_OUT_OF_SCOPE nonfleet with owner=tsukuroi; absent/unsafe subject => unknown without arbitrary payload echo

l1_interface_ruling.oom: Exactly one OOM_KILL_JOURNAL crit alarm per census, four separate counters user_notice/system_notice/user_unit_oom/system_unit_oom, never summed. Unknown arms remain explicitly unknown/unavailable; a known positive arm still alarms.
l1_interface_ruling.signal: User process SIGKILL records OR user UNIT_RESULT=signal records trigger one KILL_SIGNAL_JOURNAL warn, with separate per-path counts (never sum); unit result signal alone does not establish signal 9 or sender. System generic unit signal results remain informational.
l1_interface_ruling.generic_unit_failure_severity: info for both fleet UNIT_FAILURE_JOURNAL (user) / UNIT_FAILURE_JOURNAL_SYSTEM (system) and nonfleet UNIT_FAILURE_OUT_OF_SCOPE (user) / UNIT_FAILURE_OUT_OF_SCOPE_SYSTEM (system); all have explicit scope and preserve the user stable IDs
l1_interface_ruling.unknown_subject: UNIT_FAILURE_UNATTRIBUTED_JOURNAL info, scope=user|system count=N owner=unresolved reason=subject-metadata-unknown
l1_interface_ruling.subject_selection: Exactly one valid UNIT or USER_UNIT field, independent of journal scope; both present is unknown even when identical. No fallback to emitter metadata.
l1_interface_ruling.rule: classification_rule=unit-name-token, historical case-insensitive shokunin|ufo-sighting|tmux-spawn|the-tick|fleet; no claim of exhaustive fleet membership
l1_interface_ruling.finding_tally: drift counts warning/critical finding lines, not notice records or killed processes
